meta.name: OTONOM
meta.status: Selected concept; production approvals and trademark screening outstanding

logo.switchPlacement: Third character O, horizontal pill toggle

usageRecommendations.horizontalLogoMinWidthScreenPx: 240 suggested, not a validated absolute minimum
usageRecommendations.icon: Use standalone toggle mark for small digital surfaces only; a derived asset
usageRecommendations.safeArea: At least half the O cap height surrounding the graphic (approx. 51 units on SVG design coordinates), outside the art bounds
usageRecommendations.print: Measure actual manufacturing surface, conduct physical contrast and stroke tests; use monochrome for engraving
usageRecommendations.animation: Never represent dynamic ON/OFF state by changing the company logo; implement separate UI control
